pokedexEntries.bk: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

pokedexEntries.wh: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn’t notice attacks.

pokedexEntries.sw: Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

pokedexEntries.sh: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.
